properties.displayName: [WEEKLY] Package-manager child process credential fan-out with public egress (Mini Shai-Hulud / TeamPCP worm chain)
properties.description:
Detects the canonical post-install supply-chain worm chain: a Node/Python/Ruby package-manager process (or any child it spawns) reads three or more distinct developer-secret files (.npmrc, .pypirc, .aws/credentials, .ssh/id_*, .kube/config, .docker/config.json, .git-credentials, .env, .vault-token, NPM_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN env caches) AND establishes outbound egress to a public host, all inside a 5-minute correlation window rooted at the install. This is the joint pattern driving this fortnight's storm: Mini Shai-Hulud Wave 4 against @tanstack (Snyk, May 11), the follow-on OpenAI device compromise via TanStack (THN, May 15), TeamPCP's Checkmarx Jenkins AST plugin trojan (THN, May 11), malicious node-ipc versions exfiltrating to sh.azurestaticprovider.net (StepSecurity, May 15), QLNX Linux RAT (THN, May 8), and ESET's ScarCruft sqgame supply-chain DLL side-load (May 5). The detection spans install (compromised package execution) → actions (credential collection) → c2 (exfil), and is specifically engineered to ignore IOC rotation — the same TanStack worm has cycled IPs/domains weekly. It fires when a worm post-install script harvests then beacons; it does NOT fire on benign `npm install` (single .npmrc read, no egress), nor on standalone dev-tooling that reads credentials without spawning network traffic, nor on routine outbound from VS Code / language servers that never touch secret files.

Rationale: Every article in scope shares the same hinge: attacker code lands as a legitimate package install (npm/pypi/Jenkins plugin/game installer DLL side-load) and the very first post-install action is to enumerate developer credential stores then ship them outbound. Single-event detections in the catalogue catch one slice (QLNX's fan-out, node-ipc's beacon) — none correlates install + fan-out + egress in a 5-minute window, which is what raises this from noisy hunt to alerting-grade.
properties.query:
let WindowSec = 300;
let SecretFilePatterns = dynamic(["/.npmrc", "/.pypirc", ".aws/credentials", ".aws/config", "/.ssh/id_", "/.kube/config", ".docker/config.json", "/.git-credentials", "/.gitconfig", "/.env", "/.netrc", "/.vault-token", "NPM_TOKEN", "GITHUB_TOKEN", "pypi-token"]);
let PkgMgrs = dynamic(["node.exe","npm.exe","npx.exe","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","pip.exe","pip3.exe","python.exe","python3.exe","ruby.exe","node","npm","npx","yarn","pnpm","pip","pip3","python","python3","ruby","gem","bundle"]);
let PkgProcs = ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
    | where TargetProcessName has_any (PkgMgrs) or ParentProcessName has_any (PkgMgrs)
    | project PkgTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
              PkgFile = TargetProcessName, PkgCmd = TargetProcessCommandLine,
              PkgParent = ParentProcessName;
let SecretReads = ImFileEvent
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where EventType in ("FileCreated","FileModified","FileAccessed")
    | where TargetFilePath has_any (SecretFilePatterns)
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (PkgMgrs)
       or ActingProcessName has_any ("sh","bash","zsh","cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe")
    | project SecretTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              ReaderName = ActingProcessName, SecretPath = TargetFilePath;
let Beacons = ImNetworkSession
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
    | where isnotempty(DstIpAddr)
    | where not(ipv4_is_private(DstIpAddr))
    | where ActingProcessName has_any (PkgMgrs)
       or ActingProcessName has_any ("curl","wget","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","bitsadmin.exe")
    | project NetTime = TimeGenerated, DvcHostname,
              BeaconName = ActingProcessName, DstIpAddr, Url, DstPortNumber;
PkgProcs
| join kind=inner SecretReads on DvcHostname
| where SecretTime between (PkgTime .. PkgTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| summarize SecretCount = dcount(SecretPath),
            Secrets = make_set(SecretPath, 20),
            FirstSecretTime = min(SecretTime)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, PkgTime, PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd
| where SecretCount >= 3
| join kind=inner Beacons on DvcHostname
| where NetTime between (PkgTime .. PkgTime + WindowSec * 1s)
| summarize C2_IPs = make_set(DstIpAddr, 20),
            C2_Urls = make_set(Url, 20),
            FirstNetTime = min(NetTime)
            by DvcHostname, ActorUsername, PkgTime, PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd, SecretCount, Secrets
| project TimeGenerated = PkgTime, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          PkgFile, PkgParent, PkgCmd,
          SecretCount, Secrets,
          InstallToNetSec = datetime_diff('second', FirstNetTime, PkgTime),
          C2_IPs, C2_Urls
| order by TimeGenerated desc
